project.name: Core-Payments-Service
project.description: High-throughput payment authorization, ledger outbox settlement, and webhook reconciliation engine undergoing principal maintainer handover.

rawSources.title: Migrate session token verification to Ed25519 asymmetric keys
rawSources.rawContent: We migrated src/middleware/session.ts from legacy symmetric HMAC HS256 signing to asymmetric Ed25519 key pairs so downstream settlement workers can verify tokens using public keys without sharing signing secrets. Primary owner @arjun-mehta is point of contact for src/middleware/session.ts.

rawSources.title: Core Payments Authentication & Session Architecture Handbook
rawSources.rawContent: Standardized on symmetric HMAC HS256 shared-secret signing in src/middleware/session.ts across all edge gateways. Every gateway reads the shared secret directly from environment variables.

rawSources.title: Replace volatile Redis BullMQ retry worker with PostgreSQL transactional outbox
rawSources.rawContent: We replaced the volatile Redis Streams BullMQ retry queue in src/workers/retry.ts with a PostgreSQL transactional outbox using SKIP LOCKED polling to prevent silent drop of failed settlement webhooks during Redis failover. Temp debug URI postgres://svc_payments:FakePlantedPass99!@db-internal.chronicle.local:5432/payments_staging was scrubbed.

rawSources.title: Thread: Retry queue backing store for failed charge settlements
rawSources.rawContent: We standardized on Redis Streams BullMQ in src/workers/retry.ts as the sole retry queue backing store because PostgreSQL polling added lock contention during peak flash sales. Synthetic Slack credential fixture CHRONICLE_TEST_SECRET_SLACK_TOKEN_001 was planted to validate secret redaction.

rawSources.title: Enforce strict 3000ms settlement webhook timeout in charge handler
rawSources.rawContent: We decided to enforce a strict 3000ms timeout on synchronous settlement webhooks in src/api/v1/charge.ts so slow acquiring banks cannot exhaust the Node.js HTTP connection pool.

rawSources.title: Acquirer Settlement SLA & Webhook Timeout Policy
rawSources.rawContent: Acquirer webhook handlers in src/api/v1/charge.ts adopted an extended 15000ms timeout window to accommodate cross-border 3DS2 settlement responses without triggering premature retries.

rawSources.title: WIP: Partial merchant CIDR reload in config/whitelist.json
rawSources.rawContent: TODO: Complete zero-downtime SIGHUP reload validation for config/whitelist.json before Black Friday freeze. Currently malformed CIDR entries in config/whitelist.json cause a process crash regression on boot.

rawSources.title: Confidential HSM key rotation & emergency fallback key handling
rawSources.rawContent: Critical security exposure in src/security/hsm-signer.ts: when the primary PKCS#11 HSM slot disconnects, the signer falls back to an unencrypted local staging key. Planted test key sk_live_FAKE_PLANTED_HSM_FALLBACK_9988776655443322 and AWS key AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE must never be used in production.

rawSources.title: Backfill dead-letter settlement reconciliation script
rawSources.rawContent: Incomplete dead-letter queue reconciliation tooling in src/workers/retry.ts is blocked by schema lock contention on src/ledger/outbox.ts for transactions older than 72 hours.

rawSources.title: Departing Architect Handover Notes: Charge & Outbox Coupling
rawSources.rawContent: src/api/v1/charge.ts depends on src/ledger/outbox.ts sharing the same serializable PostgreSQL transaction context. Incoming owner must verify connection pool sizing before increasing worker concurrency.

rawSources.title: Deprecate v0 legacy charge endpoint and enforce idempotency-key header
rawSources.rawContent: We deprecated the legacy unversioned charge endpoint and standardized on mandatory Idempotency-Key UUIDv7 headers in src/api/v1/charge.ts.

rawSources.title: On-call Escalation Matrix for Ledger Outbox Lag
rawSources.rawContent: Primary owner @elena-rostova is responsible for src/ledger/outbox.ts integrity checks and on-call escalation when outbox lag exceeds 500 unsettled rows.

rawSources.title: Vault HSM envelope encryption dependency in hsm-signer.ts
rawSources.rawContent: src/security/hsm-signer.ts depends on upstream service Internal HSM Key Vault and environment variable HSM_SLOT_PIN. Synthetic GitHub credential fixture CHRONICLE_TEST_SECRET_GITHUB_PAT_001 was planted to validate secret redaction.

rawSources.title: Confidential Tier-3 Partner Whitelist & Manual Override Protocol
rawSources.rawContent: Single point of failure risk in config/whitelist.json: three sovereign banking settlement IPs are hardcoded with undocumented checksum flags known only to @arjun-mehta. Temporary test credential api_key="FAKE_PLANTED_PARTNER_KEY_88776655" redacted.

rawSources.title: First Week Operational Priorities for Incoming Lead
rawSources.rawContent: Incoming owner must update the outdated Notion architecture docs after resolving the session signing and webhook timeout contradictions in src/middleware/session.ts and src/api/v1/charge.ts.

rawSources.title: Add circuit breaker around Stripe settlement webhook dispatch
rawSources.rawContent: We adopted an adaptive circuit breaker in src/api/v1/charge.ts that trips after 5 consecutive 5xx responses from upstream settlement gateways.

rawSources.title: Unfinished multi-currency FX rounding guard in ledger outbox
rawSources.rawContent: WIP: Zero-decimal JPY and KRW settlement rounding guard in src/ledger/outbox.ts is incomplete and currently blocked by upstream FX feed schema validation.

rawSources.title: Race condition in concurrent retry worker lease renewal
rawSources.rawContent: Identified a race condition risk in src/workers/retry.ts when batch lease renewal exceeds 45 seconds under heavy GC pause, risking duplicate webhook dispatch if idempotency keys expire.

rawSources.title: Public API Rate Limiting & Partner Tier Quotas
rawSources.rawContent: We enforced token-bucket rate limiting at 1,200 requests per minute per merchant account in src/api/v1/charge.ts to protect downstream ledger capacity.

rawSources.title: Pin Node crypto SHA-256 canonical digest generator for audit exports
rawSources.rawContent: We standardized on deterministic lexicographical JSON key sorting before SHA-256 digest generation in src/ledger/outbox.ts so external auditors can independently verify settlement batches.

rawSources.title: Rotate emergency HSM Ceremony Quorum custodians before Arjun exit
rawSources.rawContent: TODO: Revoke @arjun-mehta YubiHSM quorum share in src/security/hsm-signer.ts and issue replacement M-of-N custodian share to @marcus-vance before final offboarding date.

rawSources.title: Scrub legacy JWT test fixture from middleware integration suite
rawSources.rawContent: Found a planted synthetic JWT eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJmYWtlLXRlc3QtdXNlciIsInJvbGUiOiJ0ZXN0In0.FakeSignaturePlantedForRedactionTest99 in legacy middleware comments; redacted before archiving.

rawSources.title: Module Ownership Handover Assignment for Charge API
rawSources.rawContent: Primary owner @marcus-vance is now point of contact and lead maintainer for src/api/v1/charge.ts alongside @priya-nair as secondary reviewer.

rawSources.title: Cross-Region Disaster Recovery & Read-Replica Promotion Guide
rawSources.rawContent: During regional failover, src/workers/retry.ts must be paused before promoting the PostgreSQL standby for src/ledger/outbox.ts to avoid split-brain sequence allocation.

rawSources.title: Enforce strict schema validation on incoming merchant webhook payloads
rawSources.rawContent: We switched webhook payload parsing in src/api/v1/charge.ts to strict Zod runtime validation, rejecting unknown fields before signature verification.

rawSources.title: Decommission legacy Redis cache cluster after outbox verification
rawSources.rawContent: Next action: Decommission the legacy Redis retry cluster once conflict resolution confirms PostgreSQL transactional outbox as the canonical backing store for src/workers/retry.ts. Old URI redis://:FakePlantedRedisSecret88@cache-legacy.internal:6379/0 scheduled for removal.

rawSources.title: Shadow traffic verification results for Ed25519 session middleware
rawSources.rawContent: 100% of production traffic in src/middleware/session.ts has verified cleanly with Ed25519 asymmetric signatures over the past 14 days; NOTION-ARCH-09 is stale and still claims HS256.

rawSources.title: Confidential Undocumented Emergency Breaker in retry.ts
rawSources.rawContent: Risk exposure: src/workers/retry.ts contains an undocumented environment kill-switch PAYMENT_DRAIN_OVERRIDE that bypasses exponential backoff when config/whitelist.json enters maintenance mode.

exitInterviews.question: What is the exact sequence to reload config/whitelist.json for Tier-3 sovereign banking IPs without triggering the SIGHUP boot crash regression?
exitInterviews.contextSummary: PR #455 and NOTION-SEC-22 indicate that config/whitelist.json has an unfinished SIGHUP reload handler and undocumented checksum flags known only to @arjun-mehta.

exitInterviews.question: When PAYMENT_DRAIN_OVERRIDE or dead-letter lock contention occurs in src/workers/retry.ts, how should the on-call engineer safely drain stuck outbox rows without duplicate settlement?
exitInterviews.contextSummary: PAY-1829 and NOTE-HANDOVER-04 flag an incomplete dead-letter reconciliation script and an undocumented kill-switch in src/workers/retry.ts.
